records.rationale: Full original two-path patch read. Preserve state strings, asynchronous Android events, UDC none alias and configured build through final 957b40b3b769 split notification implementation. Old android_setup iteration and singleton/configfs-embedded work were explicitly removed and replaced; current setup/reset/disconnect/suspend/resume/unbind wrappers are native LTS. Accessory pre-configuration handling survives through the separate bounded android_acc_* path. Do not restore old wrapper null/lifetime races or old function-instance traversal. Current notification safety adaptations are documented separately.

Full original patch read. Keep actual Android class creation/destruction and instance-specific event targets via the final replacement implementation. Original global create_function_device and its replacement android_create_function_device were explicitly retired by later ACK removal; no obsolete singleton child-device API or stale global event pointer is resurrected. teardown now destroys the exact live instance and drains work before containing gadget release.

Full state-file addition/error-cleanup patch read. Retain the user-visible read-only state attribute through current class dev_groups/state_show, with drvdata pointing to per-gadget options. 75d587b500e8 locks the snapshot and reports real configuration/disconnect state. Class-managed groups and exact-instance unregister supersede manual attribute loops and unsafe post-config_item_put cleanup. Positive UsbDeviceManager state reader is pinned in usb-notification-review.

Full helper extraction patch read. Preserve instance create/destroy abstraction and config-disabled stubs in the split notification library. Current class attribute groups replace manual loops; native gadget allocation flow plus corrected one-time frees replaces historical error labels. Device teardown precedes config_item_put, and work cannot be enqueued after dev is unpublished. Preserve live state behavior rather than replaying old singleton layout.

Full two-hunk unique merge resolution read. Retain native gi spinlock/unbind state and locked setup/disconnect/suspend/resume wrappers. Android events are implemented in separate per-cdev options and composite notifications. Old Android direct setup/disconnect callbacks and direct composite fallback are superseded by these native lifetime gates; all six native wrapper/unbind functions are byte-identical to LTS. Native dedicated reset supersedes the historical reset-as-disconnect binding.

Full multi-instance patch read. Keep distinct androidN devices, per-instance drvdata and event targets using final ACK IDA allocation. Adapt teardown to exact device_unregister rather than same-devt lookup, keep ID reserved until the old sysfs name is removed, and drain before containing gadget release. Old monotonic gadget_index and teardown after config_item_put are superseded. Host two-instance model reproduces old wrong-instance teardown and verifies the adapted path.

Full relocation/conditional-compilation patch read. Its purpose was avoiding unused native wrappers when old android_setup/android_disconnect replaced them. Final ACK removed those wrappers and current code always uses native configfs callbacks with split notifications. No old declaration move or conditional exclusion is needed; all native callback functions remain compiled and unchanged.

Full disconnect refactor read. Retain the safety effect through native configfs_composite_disconnect null checks, gi spinlock and unbind check before composite_disconnect. Accessory cleanup and Android disconnected notification now occur in __composite_disconnect reached through that native gate. Do not restore the old callback that derived gi from potentially null cdev or scheduled work without final teardown synchronization. Current source preserves native reset distinction.

Full two-file bounds patch read. Its historical acc_ctrlrequest_composite is replaced by current android_acc_setup_composite with the same EP0 size limit: clamp oversized IN length, reject oversized OUT before __acc_setup. Current native composite_setup also checks the control length before accessory dispatch, providing an earlier guard. Whole current wrapper equals final ACK; no claim of complete accessory protocol review or runtime USB fuzzing is made by this narrowly scoped decision.

Full unique merge resolution read. Preserve its correction routing failed Android-device creation through name cleanup. Current source also separately owns the function string; 75d587b500e8 orders labels so each allocated name/function/gi is freed once, correcting the later ACK double-free regression. Host allocation-failure model checks all three failure stages. Native successful construction remains unchanged apart from Android instance creation.

Full one-line API conversion read. The old dynamic class_create call is replaced by final ACK static android_usb_class plus native class_register/class_unregister. Retain native class API and current class groups; neither old THIS_MODULE argument nor obsolete singleton class creation is required. No class access or lifetime checks are removed.

Full include-resolution diff read. Keep Android notification header and native u_os_desc.h; obsolete u_f.h is removed as upstream requires. Current include block matches this effect and the existing build succeeds. This merge changes declaration wiring only, not request handling or security policy.
